Argentina Wellness: Buenos Aires & Iguazú

Experience a unique blend of wellness and nature in Argentina, combining the vibrant city life of Buenos Aires with the breathtaking natural beauty of Iguazú. Enjoy mindful activities, immersive nature experiences, and authentic local cuisine, all designed to foster relaxation, connection, and well-being throughout your journey.

sections.title: Day 2 - Buenos Aires Wellness City Tour
sections.html:
Private City Tour & Urban Wellness Experience

We recommend a City Tour & Urban Wellness Experience to give the itinerary an authentic wellness identity, combining Buenos Aires’ main green spaces with activities focused on connecting with nature, mindfulness and healthy gastronomy. The visit begins at Carlos Thays Botanical Garden, where guests will enjoy a leisurely walk along its paths and among its diverse plant species, with moments dedicated to mindful observation and breathing exercises. Continue to the Japanese Garden, an oasis of serenity in the heart of the city. Explore its gardens, bridges and ponds, with time for quiet contemplation and connecting with nature. The experience continues at Palermo Rose Garden (El Rosedal), where guests can enjoy a relaxing walk along its paths and green spaces.

Lunch at Gioia Cocina Botánica

At midday, enjoy a distinctive experience at Gioia Cocina Botánica (Monday to Saturday), located at Palacio Duhau – Park Hyatt Buenos Aires. Its botanical-inspired cuisine places seasonal vegetables, legumes, mushrooms and fresh ingredients at the heart of a creative and refined gastronomic proposal. Set in an elegant atmosphere overlooking the hotel’s gardens, this experience invites guests to discover a mindful approach to lunch, celebrating natural flavors, seasonal produce and the connection between gastronomy and well-being. Includes: Three-course à la carte lunch, One glass of wine selected by the sommelier, One non-alcoholic beverage, One coffee or tea, accompanied by petit fours.

Estado Puro Spa Experience

Free time to enjoy Estado Puro Spa, where guests can relax and rejuvenate with the hydrotherapy circuit, whirlpool, heated loungers, dry and steam saunas, and a sensory experience featuring special showers. Return to the hotel.

sections.title: Day 4 - Iguazu Falls and Jungle Market
sections.html:
Iguazu Falls Argentine Side Immersive Nature Experience

Discover Iguazu Falls from the Argentine (including National Park Fee) side through an immersive nature experience that combines breathtaking landscapes, biodiversity and mindful connection with the surrounding environment. Accompanied by a guide, explore the walkways and trails of Iguazu National Park, surrounded by lush subtropical rainforest. During the visit, take time to appreciate the sounds of the jungle, observe the local flora and fauna, and connect with nature at a relaxed pace. The tour includes the park’s main circuits, offering different perspectives of the spectacular waterfalls, including the iconic Devil’s Throat, subject to park operations. Throughout the experience, moments of mindful observation and quiet contemplation invite guests to slow down, engage their senses and fully appreciate the power and beauty of nature.

Visit to Yabuticaba Jungle Market

After visiting Iguazu Falls on the Argentine side, continue to Yabuticaba Jungle Market (Mercado de la Selva Yabuticaba), where guests can discover local products and regional flavors, offering an authentic introduction to the culture and natural richness of Misiones. Return to the hotel in the afternoon, with free time to relax and enjoy the natural surroundings.

Dinner at Green Mandioca – Selvaje Lodge

Enjoy a distinctive dining experience at Green Mandioca, where regional cuisine celebrates the authentic flavors of Misiones through locally sourced ingredients, seasonal produce and traditional culinary influences. The experience includes a two-course menu and one beverage per person, served in a peaceful setting surrounded by the lush subtropical rainforest. A perfect way to round off the day, combining authentic regional flavors with the serenity of the jungle.

sections.title: Day 5 - Iguazu Falls Brazilian Side and Yoga
sections.html:
Iguazu Falls Brazilian Side Immersive Nature Experience

Discover Iguazu Falls from the Brazilian side (including National Park Fee) through an immersive nature experience, enjoying unique panoramic views of one of South America’s most breathtaking landscapes. Accompanied by a guide, explore the walkways of Iguaçu National Park, which offer different perspectives of the majestic waterfalls and allow visitors to appreciate the sheer scale of the falls from a privileged vantage point. During the walk, take time to admire the scenery, observe the subtropical vegetation and connect with the sounds and energy of the rainforest. The visit invites guests to enjoy the natural surroundings at a relaxed pace, with moments for mindful observation, photography and quiet contemplation of this extraordinary setting. At the end of the tour, return to the hotel, with free time to relax.

Yoga Session at Selvaje Lodge

Enjoy a rejuvenating yoga session during your stay at Selvaje Lodge. Surrounded by the peaceful natural environment of the rainforest, this practice offers an opportunity to relax, reconnect with yourself and restore balance between body and mind.

Tango & Cultural Wellness Experience in La Ventana Tango

Discover the passion and elegance of Argentine tango through an introductory dance lesson, exploring posture, balance, movement and connection through music. In the evening, enjoy a traditional tango dinner show featuring professional dancers and live music, offering an authentic introduction to Buenos Aires’ cultural heritage. A unique experience that combines movement, artistic expression and local traditions.
